ITEM 1 | Small mound of fine, granular white-grey grains with a slightly speckled, matte surface, spread roughly 6 cm by 5 cm on the right side of a white square plate, with faint tan-brown tinge at its edge; grains appear dry and separate, holding a loose clumped shape at about 1 cm high | 60

ITEM 2 | Two small dark brown-black cooked pieces with rough, slightly glossy surfaces, each about 1.5 cm across, sitting at the top and right edges of the grain mound, one partly tucked under the grains | 8
